_meta.source: Tool roundups Oct 2026 + references 09,13,14,15. Generator themes are imported live from generate_pptx.THEMES at DB build (single source of truth).

tools.name: think-cell
tools.superpower: Waterfall/Gantt/Mekko + live Excel links, CAGR arrows

tools.name: MS Copilot in PowerPoint
tools.verdict: Best AI-in-the-real-tool; no export problem. No Morph choreography.

tools.name: Gamma
tools.verdict: PPTX export flattens/shifts (~30% editable text reported); draft only.

tools.name: Canva
tools.verdict: Some effects flatten on PPTX export.

tools.name: Prezi
tools.verdict: No meaningful PPTX export; different medium.

tools.name: Slidesgo
tools.verdict: Fast free starts; check license tier.

tools.name: Flaticon / Noun Project / Iconscout / Icons8
tools.verdict: One style per deck; recolor to accent.

tools.name: remove.bg / Squoosh
tools.verdict: Keep decks light for smooth Morph.

prompts.name: Big Idea extractor
prompts.text: Act as a presentation strategist trained in Nancy Duarte's method. Topic: [TOPIC]. Audience: [WHO]. I want them to [DECISION/ACTION]. Give me 5 candidate Big Idea sentences — each states a unique point of view, conveys what's at stake, one complete sentence. Rank them, flag the strongest. No slide content yet.

prompts.name: SCQA opener
prompts.text: Write an SCQA opening: Situation (1 agreed sentence), Complication (1 sentence, what broke), Question (implied), Answer (my recommendation, 1 sentence = governing thought). Max 4 sentences. Context: [PASTE]. Recommendation: [PASTE].

prompts.name: Pyramid ghost deck
prompts.text: Structure as Minto pyramid: line 1 = single-sentence answer; then 3-4 MECE supporting arguments with evidence bullets; then convert to a ghost deck of complete-sentence action titles (<=15 words, active voice, quantified). Material: [PASTE].

prompts.name: Assertion-headline converter
prompts.text: Rewrite these topic titles as assertion headlines: full-sentence conclusions (max 2 lines), specific and quantified; read together they must tell the whole story (horizontal logic). Titles+content: [PASTE].

prompts.name: Sparkline storyteller
prompts.text: Outline a [X]-min talk on [TOPIC] with Duarte's sparkline: what-is opener (<=10%), call to adventure, alternating IS/COULD-BE beats, one STAR moment ~70% (give 3 options), new-bliss ending + explicit CTA. Per slide: beat label, assertion headline, visual idea.

prompts.name: Deck-spec JSON generator
prompts.text: Using generator/deck-spec.example.json format and reference/03 recipes: create a complete spec for [USE CASE] about [TOPIC], audience [WHO], [N] slides, theme [THEME]. Enforce assertion headlines, <=3 bullets x <=7 words, ~30 words/slide, finding-titled charts, speaker notes everywhere, specific closing ask. Output ONLY valid JSON. Source: [PASTE].

prompts.name: Data-slide surgeon
prompts.text: From this data [PASTE]: (1) the one defensible finding = headline sentence; (2) chart type + 1-line justification; (3) strategic gray: which ONE bar/series gets accent + why; (4) KEY INSIGHT rail text (1-2 sentences); (5) clutter deletion list.

prompts.name: Bullet-to-visual converter
prompts.text: Convert these bullets to visuals: choose per group process/grid/comparison/hero-stat/chart; write exact labels (heads <=4 words, bodies <=12). No bullet list survives. Bullets: [PASTE].

prompts.name: Speaker-notes writer
prompts.text: Write presenter notes per slide: talk track ~60-90s conversational, one transition sentence, one likely question + crisp answer. Slides: [PASTE TITLES+CONTENT].

prompts.name: Deck critic
prompts.text: Review against Richard Mayer coherence/signaling/redundancy, assertion-evidence, horizontal+vertical logic, reverse storyboard. Per slide: headline verdict, words to cut, one fix. Then top-5 changes by impact. Be ruthless. Deck: [PASTE].

prompts.name: Reel script (PlacePlate formula)
prompts.text: 20-second IG/TikTok reel script showing this deck's Morph (no face-cam): 3 hook text options, shot list (slide flips 2-3s each, STAR last), caption <=150 chars with link-in-bio CTA, hashtag block (#powerpoint #morphtransition #powerpointpresentation #powerpointtemplate #presentation). Theme: [X].

prompts.name: Arabic localization pass
prompts.text: Localize to professional Saudi-business Arabic (not literal): assertion headlines <=2 lines, bullets <=7 words, Western numerals unless told. Flag cultural adaptations; give EN captions for bilingual slides; list layout elements to mirror. Text: [PASTE].

palettes_extra.name: Okabe-Ito (colorblind-safe categorical)
palettes_extra.use: Multi-category charts; yellow for fills only (1.32:1 on white); still check WCAG contrast per background

palettes_extra.name: Strategic-gray chart scheme
palettes_extra.use: All bars gray except the finding bar in accent (PlacePlate/Knaflic)
